{{Quote|So good, you'd swear they were made by the Soup People of Tureen VI.|Dexter Jettster, on the quality of his soups|<ref name="Dex" />}}
'''Tureen VI''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Dex">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> in the [[Tureen system/Legends|Tureen system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Kriz sector/Legends|Kriz sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin of the [[Soup People]], a group known for making high-quality [[Soup/Legends|soup]]. The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] wrote in the menu for his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], that his soups were good enough to make their [[Diet/Legends|eaters]] think they were made by the Soup People of Tureen VI.<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Silly, but it works as a throwaway reference.|Gregory Walker|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>}}
Tureen VI was introduced in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] and formatted as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex" /> Walker called it a silly throwaway reference<ref name="Blog" /> as a [[Wikipedia:Tureen|tureen]] is a dish used to hold soup.<ref name="Tureen">{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/tureen|text=Tureen definition|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20210421043617}}</ref> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Tureen [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Tureen VI, in grid square J-18.<ref name="TEA" />
